entities.summary: Donald Glenn Horn is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback for eight seasons in the National Football League (NFL) with the Green Bay Packers, Denver Broncos, Cleveland Browns, and San Diego Chargers. He played college football for the San Diego State Aztecs.
